_readme: Weekday breakfast ideas: healthy, no added sugar (fruit is fine). One line per idea. Edit freely; ids must stay unique. Seeded into the recipe table (meal_type 'breakfast') at startup; new ids are added, existing rows are never overwritten. overnightPrep=true triggers the 8 pm soak reminder when the idea is planned for the next morning.
